title: The Art, Science & Healing of Head & Neck Reconstruction

guests.name: Dr. Christopher Yao
guests.title: Head and Neck Surgeon and Researcher at University Health Network

guests.name: Dr. Rosemary Martino
guests.title: Speech Language Pathologist and Researcher at University Health Network

notes: In this episode, we follow the story of Mr. Patel, who underwent life-changing surgery after an oral cancer diagnosis that affected his tongue. Mr. Patel offers an unfiltered look at his recovery and reflects on how stigma shaped his experience with diagnosis and healing. Alongside him, we hear from Dr. Christopher Yao, a head and neck reconstructive surgeon advancing innovations in cancer care and reconstruction, and Dr. Rosemary Martino, a speech-language pathologist and researcher leading new approaches to swallowing recovery and rehabilitation for patients like Mr. Patel.
